matches.title: Check a complete rational spectrum claim for a symmetric matrix
matches.description: For a bounded symmetric matrix over QQ and pairwise-distinct rational eigenvalue claims, return the retained source and exact shifted-nullity ledger, and decide whether the claimed multiplicities give the complete spectrum. A claim is complete exactly when every multiplicity equals its nullity and the multiplicities sum to the matrix order.

matches.title: Compute the exact rational (Frobenius) canonical form
matches.description: Compute the invariant factors, characteristic polynomial, and minimal polynomial of a square rational matrix via Smith normal form of tI - A over QQ[t].

matches.title: Compute an exact rational matrix determinant (det)
matches.description: Compute the determinant of one square matrix over QQ through order 64 with SymPy's exact Bareiss algorithm.

matches.title: Compute Sylvester inertia of a symmetric rational matrix
matches.description: Given a symmetric rational matrix, compute its Sylvester inertia (n_positive, n_negative, n_zero) and definiteness classification using exact rational LDL decomposition.

matches.title: Solve an exact rational linear system
matches.description: Classify and solve a bounded square system Ax=b over QQ, returning a unique solution only when one exists.
